skills.name: Puppet's Advent
skills.description: Eris fires a bullet at the enemy with the lowest HP, dealing 200% ATK as Physical DMG. Each Puppet also fires a bullet, dealing DMG equal to 300% of the Puppet's ATK.

upgrades.level2: Eris's bullet DMG increases to 300% ATK.
upgrades.level3: Each Puppet bullet additionally deals DMG equal to 7.5% of the target's missing HP (up to 600% of the Puppet's ATK).
upgrades.level4: Eris's bullet additionally deals DMG equal to 15% of the target's Max HP (up to 500% of Eris's ATK).

skills.name: Mystic Threads
skills.description: Fires a bullet dealing 100% DMG to the target and summons a Puppet for 30s. The Puppet inherits 20% of Eris's ATK and Max HP. Puppets attack whenever Eris performs a Basic Attack, dealing DMG equal to 100% of their ATK. Eris can have up to 3 Puppets.

upgrades.level2: Puppet inheritance increases to 30% of Eris's ATK and Max HP.
upgrades.level3: Each Basic Attack reduces this skill's cooldown by 0.5s.
upgrades.level4: Puppets inherit 60% of Eris's ATK and 30% of Eris's Max HP.

skills.name: Puppet Decoy
skills.description: When Eris takes lethal damage, she becomes untargetable for 3s. This effect has a 30s cooldown.

upgrades.level4: When Eris participates in killing an enemy unit, this skill's cooldown is reduced by 7.5s.

skills.name: Summoning Threads
skills.description: Passive: When any allied unit other than a Puppet falls, summon 1 Puppet at their location. Puppets last 25s and inherit 60% of Eris's ATK and 30% of her Max HP. Maximum 3 Puppets.

relic.name: Puppet's Hex
relic.description: Eris marks her current target. Damage dealt by Eris and her Puppets ignores 30% of the target's DEF.

upgrades.level3: Enemy Deity deaths can also trigger Puppet summoning.
